headword: お{試|ため}し{期間|きかん}

definitions.gloss: trial period; free trial; probationary period
definitions.explanation: A limited time during which a product or service can be used for free or at a reduced cost, or a period during which a new employee is evaluated before permanent hiring.

examples.japanese: お{試|ため}し{期間|きかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三十日間|さんじゅうにちかん}です。
examples.english: The trial period is thirty days.

examples.japanese: お{試|ため}し{期間|きかん}{中|ちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{解約|かいやく}→解約：06129_kaiyaku⟧⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦かかりません→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: If you cancel during the trial period, there will be no charge.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{試|ため}し{期間|きかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧みて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}められる→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: This app has a trial period, so you can try it for free first before deciding whether to purchase.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in marketing for subscription services, software, and online platforms. Also used in employment contexts for probationary periods (⟦{試用期間|しようきかん}→試用期間：15675_shiyoukikan⟧ is the more formal equivalent). The お prefix adds a polite, customer-friendly tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{試|ため}し{期間|きかん}{中|ちゅう} (during the trial period)
- お{試|ため}し{期間|きかん}{終了|しゅうりょう} (end of the trial period)
- ⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧お{試|ため}し{期間|きかん} (free trial period)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{試用期間|しようきかん}→試用期間：15675_shiyoukikan⟧: probationary period — more formal, often used for employment
- トライアル: trial — loanword used in similar contexts
